consumer: The frontend status panel renderer reads the snapshot's avatar.stamina/avatar.pain scalars and SHOWS them; it asks 'what raw value should I print', not a yes/no -- no engine condition/mission/dialogue check consumes these scalars for the stated goal
scope: only the avatar's own scalar status values (the character itself); not nearby entities, carried items, or any map region
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar (scalars) -- writes ctx.u.get_stamina() and ctx.u.get_pain() straight from the engine getters into the snapshot JSON with no filtering/formatting/lag layer; the getter result IS the authoritative ground truth
divergence: After the avatar sprints, the engine's get_stamina() is depleted (e.g. 3000 of 8000) or pain is nonzero from a fresh injury, but a wrong implementation reports a stale/full stamina or pain=0 -- the reported scalar diverges from the engine's actual raw value
